description.value:
A mutated hound-thing, too many teeth for the mouth it's wearing. Fast, aggressive, built to close distance and not let go.

SIGNATURE — its bite can drag a Marked target off its feet; by Alpha stage, a hit from either of you sets up the other's next attack.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too. Feral Bond growth stages (Whelp / Bonded / Alpha / Apex-Touched, classes.waywarden.json:95 terms) have no tracked data field anywhere in the corpus, so a stage requirement like "at least Alpha stage" has no roll option or actor property to predicate against.
